name: codex-novel
description: A Codex-native, local-first system for selecting, writing, reviewing, and maintaining long and short fiction.

interface.shortDescription: Build market-backed long or short fiction with Codex.
interface.longDescription: Compare market-backed topics and opening hooks for Fanqie or Zhihu Salt, lock premise, scope, abilities, evidence and reveal timing, then manage scene writing, continuity, revisions, release cadence and export.
defaultPrompt: Compare market-backed topics for Fanqie or Zhihu Salt and create a resumable fiction workspace.
Create a completed short story with dynamic character and plot cards.
Continue my novel from its last accepted chapter.
Audit this chapter for continuity and repair only blocking issues.
